translationRepairs: The Lord of Lu suspected him, so Wu Qi killed his wife to seek the generalship.
Wu Qi then went to Lu, studied military methods, and served the Lord of Lu.
s0087 is 起乃之魯，學兵法以事魯君 (Wu Qi then went to Lu, studied military methods, and served the Lord of Lu); the before text is the content of s0088 and does not translate this sentence.
The Lord of Lu suspected him, so Qi killed his wife to seek the generalship.
The Lord of Lu suspected him, so Wu Qi killed his wife to seek the generalship.
In 魯君疑之，起殺妻以求將, 起 is Wu Qi’s given name; bare English “Qi” wrongly suggests the state of Qi, and “Wu Qi” correctly identifies the agent.
After Tian Wen died, Gongsun became chancellor, married a Wei princess, and plotted against Wu Qi.
After Tian Wen died, Gongshu became chancellor, married a Wei princess, and plotted against Wu Qi.
s0131 has 公叔為相, and s0132 continues 公叔之僕; 公叔 is Gongshu, not Gongsun, so the proposed name correction matches the Chinese.
Gongsun said, “What is to be done?”
Gongshu said, “What is to be done?”
s0133 opens 公叔曰; the speaker is Gongshu, consistent with 公叔 in s0131–s0132, so replacing Gongsun is required.
When it came time for the race, Sun Tzu said: 'Now use your lowest chariot against their highest, your highest against their middle, your middle against their lowest.'
When it came time for the race, Sun Bin said: 'Now use your lowest chariot against their highest, your highest against their middle, your middle against their lowest.'
In this Sun Bin episode, 孫子曰 names Sun Bin (cf. adjacent units); English “Sun Tzu” misidentifies him as Sun Wu, and “Sun Bin” restores the correct referent.
Sun Tzu calculated their march route—they should arrive at Malings by dusk.
Sun Bin calculated their march route—they should arrive at Maling by dusk.
孫子 again refers to Sun Bin in this campaign narrative, and 馬陵 is the place name Maling; “Sun Tzu” and plural “Malings” are both wrong.
The Malings road was narrow, with many obstacles and defiles on the sides, suitable for ambushing troops. They cut a large tree white and wrote on it: 'Pang Juan dies beneath this tree.'
The Maling road was narrow, with many obstacles and defiles on the sides, suitable for ambushing troops. They cut a large tree white and wrote on it: 'Pang Juan dies beneath this tree.'
馬陵道 is the road at Maling; “Malings” is an incorrect English place-name form, and the rest of the proposed literal matches 道陜…斫大樹白而書之.
